notes:
Drive is now one personal My Drive per person plus one Shared Drive for the home, mounted on your computers.

- Each person has a private My Drive in the Hub data folder; nobody else sees it unless you share it.
- One Shared Drive holds the files for the whole home.
- Share files and folders with people as viewers or editors, and see Shared with me and Shared by me.
- Pick folders in your drive and sync them to chosen devices, like Syncthing, with conflict copies kept.
- Desktop mounts your drive as a network drive that shows its size and free space and follows your LAN or internet route.
- The mount cache removes data unused for 1 hour, with an optional size cap and free space floor in Desktop settings.
- Version history is off by default and uses space when on.
- Install the new Desktop release so the mount helper is available.
